text.tspan: Employees at BlueHenry, an Amazon selling partner that specializes in all-natural cocktail garnishes.
Millions of people work alongside Amazon to serve our customers,
including our employees, partners, suppliers, and people living in the
communities where we operate. We respect the dignity, rights, and well-
being of everyone connected to our global business. We aim to provide
products and services responsibly, work with more diverse suppliers,
and deliver positive impact in our communities.
